muc_tieu: dua BANG LENH cua tester (125 o hieu chuan) len git de cloud so TUNG LENH voi engine (chu du an duyet 09/10)
vi_sao: cloud chi thay con so tong (lai / DD / so lenh) nen biet engine lech nhung khong biet lech o lenh nao. Bang lenh nho (~1-2 MB tong), chi la lenh cua EA luoi cua ta chay tren tester cua ta. Can ma moi (lenh-v1); khong dung tester, chay duoc song song voi tester dang ban.
